fields.description: Master switch. When off, no filings or filing types can be created and auto-creation stops. Existing records stay readable.
fields.label: Enable Regulatory Filing

fields.description: Runs once a day and creates each filing ahead of its due date, for the company set on its Filing Type.
fields.label: Enable Auto-Creation

fields.description: Filings are created this many days before they are due. Missed days (e.g. server downtime) are caught up on the next run.
fields.label: Days Before Due Date

fields.description: Earliest due date to create filings for. Anything due before this is assumed to be handled outside the system.
fields.label: Generate Filings Due From
